common.brandTagline: A spring of daily food ideas

welcome.title: Some meals stay with us for years.
welcome.letter:
We made ongdalsaem to remember the meals we shared with the people who made us happy.

A warm table at home, a bowl across from a friend, even your first clumsy dish — each one holds a little time.

Share your happiest meal here.
welcome.note:
You’ll see this letter once · Read it again in Settings
› Help & policies

settings.title: Settings
settings.handleCooldown: You can change it again on {{date}}.
settings.handleTaken: That username is taken. Try another.
settings.bioPlaceholder: A line about how you cook
settings.connectedNote: Use any connected account to sign in. Keep at least one sign-in method.
settings.deleteNote: Permanently deletes your profile, dishes, photos, comments, acorns and diary. This can’t be undone.
settings.adsNote: Optional and separate from system notification permission. Ads are labeled “Ad” and include an opt-out. Night-time ads need this extra consent.
settings.defaultsNote: These are the defaults for Share publicly and Allow comments when you share. You can still change them per dish.
settings.messagesNote: Requests have no read receipts and hide photos and links until you reply.
settings.locationNote: Your exact location never leaves your phone. Shared precision sets what others see on your dishes and is turned off when location is off. System permissions can be changed in Settings.
settings.blockedNote: Blocked cooks can’t see your dishes, follow you or comment. They aren’t notified.
settings.exportFailed: Couldn’t prepare your data. Try again.
settings.languageNote: Turn off to pick a language just for ongdalsaem. Dish posts stay in the language they were written in.
settings.languageUnits: Weather words, mood tags and dates follow the language you pick. Units (°C / °F) are set separately.

settings.deleteCaption: Your account is deleted right away. Records we must keep by law (e.g., consent logs) are stored separately and never shown. Sign in with Apple / Google access is revoked.
